title: Add ILogger instrumentation to MemorySmith.Core services
description: MemorySmith.Core has zero logging across all 16 source files. No ILogger<T> usage anywhere. MemoryIndex.Remove silently returns when ID not found. MemoryStateMachine.Evaluate silently falls through when no transition matches. MemoryScorer.Score has no telemetry on scoring outliers. Inject ILogger<T> into MemoryStateMachine, MemoryIndex, and MemoryScorer. Log transitions, removal misses, scoring outliers, and rebuild events at appropriate levels. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-003

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Approved for Wave 1, execution order 08 of 09. Core instrumentation has broad diagnostic value but follows correctness and security fixes.
